title: Expose streaming and tool/function-calling support flags in model catalog listing
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: customers want to filter model candidates by runtime behavior (streaming characteristics) and by first-class tool/function-calling support when choosing a model for production routes. This PR adds explicit capabilities to the model catalog and exposes them as queryable filters on the /models endpoint so routing, SDKs, and the OpenAI-compatibility layer can make deterministic decisions. What changed: Introduced three new capability fields on model metadata: streaming_behavior (enum: "none", "chunked", "low_latency_stream"), tool_calling_support (enum: "none", "basic", "structured_function_calls"), and structured_output_schema_present (boolean string values "true"/"false" in metadata for backward compatibility). Added API query params supports_streaming, supports_tool_calling, structured_output to /v1/models listing. The OpenAI-compat shim now maps openai-like capability hints to the new fields for compatibility filtering. Also added pricing/limits hints: token_limit_range and per_token_price_hint so the console and SDKs can show rough unit economics during model selection. Implementation notes: server handler changes (catalog service + API layer), small registry DB migration to add capability columns, compatibility mapper for openai shim, TS/Python SDK type updates, docs and examples, and an e2e filter test harness. Backwards compatibility: default values are permissive (absent flags mean capability unknown and will not filter unless the query param is supplied). Migration: SQL migration script adds nullable columns and backfills from existing capability tags where available. Tests: new unit tests for filter combinator logic and an integration test that exercises an end-to-end model selection flow for a streaming tool-calling workload. Checklist: - [x] API schema and docs updated - [x] DB migration and backfill - [x] SDK typings + quickstart examples - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] OpenAI compat mapper tests - [x] Console display enhancements Rollout plan: feature gated behind "catalog_capabilities_v2" flag for two weeks; default off for Dedicated/Private to give SEs time to coordinate. After monitoring, enable cluster-wide and update public docs. Related: ENG-5921 (model selection UI), ENG-5982 (openai-compat mappings), SUP-4432 (customer support ticket requesting streaming-aware routing).

release_notes: Model catalog now exposes streaming_behavior, tool_calling_support, and structured_output_schema_present metadata fields.
New /v1/models query params: supports_streaming, supports_tool_calling, structured_output for filtering model listings.
OpenAI-compat mapper will surface capability hints to maintain compatibility with existing tooling.
Pricing/limits hints (token_limit_range, per_token_price_hint) added to model metadata to aid cost-aware selection.
